title: F-35 and KC-46 accounts distinguish delivery from readiness
summary: Two existing Atlas accounts gain twelve substantive sections and eleven dated entries. Twelve inspected primary HTML records represent ten distinct artifacts, including two report/tracker pairs. Earlier findings retain their own dates and scope.
evidence_note: Global deliveries, line output, accepted capability, time-based readiness and inventory accountability remain different measures. Initial testing is not fleet certification; preliminary and final delivery tables do not add cohorts. Three Air Force URLs returned access errors, so saved July and September observations remain explicitly historical. No restricted rates were reconstructed.
publication_effect: Local source integration only; production rendering, release and launch remain unverified.
